core_capabilities: Create a resume from scratch or import resume data from JSON, PDF, or DOCX and continue editing it in the builder.

Export the completed resume as PDF, DOCX, or JSON.
Publish or unpublish a public resume link and optionally protect it with a password.

When an AI provider is configured, analyze a resume and inspect generated feedback and scoring.
Manage account profile details and display preferences, including name, username, email, theme, and language.
Manage authentication security by setting or changing a password, enabling or disabling two-factor authentication, registering or removing passkeys, and linking supported sign-in providers.
Create, review, and revoke API keys for authenticated API access.
When server AI support is available, configure, test, enable, or remove AI providers and use them to start and manage AI agent threads against a blank or existing resume draft.
Keep private, resume-specific notes such as application history and job-description links.
Review private view and download statistics for a publicly shared resume.
Permanently delete the account and all associated data after explicit confirmation.
